messages:
Priya R.: FYI starting ~18:12 UTC we're seeing a burst of 5xx/429s from the combined embeddings+rerank endpoint in us-west. Users hit their assigned rerank lane but a lot of requests are getting queued then dropped at egress.
Marco L.: Alerts came in. Dashboard: rerank queue depth >240, embeddings lane still has slack. Should've spilled over but didn't.
Jenna S.: Is this related to the recent per-customer fairshare/lane-split change?
Priya R.: Yes — we rolled a stricter lane-split last week. Hypothesis: per-lane circuit breaker is tripping before any global spillover happens.
Hassan K.: Confirmed from router traces. CB check uses active_kv_cache + queued_count. Rerank has a lower CB threshold to protect tail latency. Large batched reranks are tripping it, causing rejects instead of promoting to embedding lane.
Marco L.: Router log excerpt: `decision=reject reason=circuit_breaker_active` and no `decision=promote_to_embed` entries for those requests.
Priya R.: Current router policy (simplified):
```
policy {
  lane: rerank
  cb_threshold: 180
  allow_spillover: false
}
```
Sam_p: Wait, why is allow_spillover=false in prod? That was supposed to be opt-in for strict isolation customers.
Priya R.: Ops flip last month set it false-by-default for some reason. We didn't expect mixed workloads where rerank spikes briefly while embed pool could absorb.
Claire M.: Support is getting complaints. Need a quick mitigation plan.
Jenna S.: Short-term options:
- enable allow_spillover in us-west (fast config change)
- raise rerank cb_threshold to 250 (risk: higher tail latency)
- add a soft-queue path returning 202 + Retry-After for clients that can retry
Which do we want to try first?
Marco L.: Allow spillover is the fastest. Also instrument promotions.
Hassan K.: I'll flip allow_spillover=true and add a size guard: only promote batches <=4 to avoid huge rerank batches killing embed pool. Pushing change now.
ops-bot: config-change /deploy allow_spillover=true target=us-west initiated by Hassan K.  CI checks passed
Marco L.: After change: rerank queue depth down ~60%, embed lane saw a small bump but stayed <60% GPU util. 429s dropped to baseline.
Priya R.: Good. Action items:
- Marco: add metric `lane_promotion.count` and histogram `promoted_batch_size` (PR to router) — due EOD
- Hassan: prototype soft-queue fallback (202 + Retry-After) for non-retrying clients — due next week
- Jenna: update the runbook with spillover conditions, rollback steps, and a checklist — due today
Sam_p: Track cost delta. If promotions become steady-state, embed token usage (and $) will rise; finance is okay short-term but not permanently.
Claire M.: I'll draft a customer note linking to the runbook and ETA.
Priya R.: Longer-term proposals: 1) dynamic CB based on global free GPU tokens instead of static per-lane thresholds, 2) per-customer overflow budgets + priority to allow graceful, billable spillovers. Add to roadmap.
Marco L.: Opening RFC for dynamic token-based CB and tagging eng-runtime + infra.
Jenna S.: Keep this thread open until runbook + metrics land. Close after confirmation.
Priya R.: Thanks all. Re-open if anything spikes again.
ops-bot: deploy complete  allow_spillover=true rolled to 4 router pods (us-west)
